name: Card Reader (Cartomancer Games)
body:
Your gift is seeing the future in the cards that you deal.

Divination (Su)

At 1st level, you can peer into the future. You lay out a series of cards in an attempt to learn more about the short-term fate of a creature within 10 feet, usually within the next day for most prosaic creatures, or the next hour or less for someone likely to have multiple rapid experiences, such as someone actively adventuring. This takes 1 minute and requires discarding 10 cards from your deck. You learn a single enigmatic word connected to the creature’s fate in that time frame. Fate is notoriously inscrutable, and the word isn’t necessarily meant to be taken at face value, so the meaning is often clear only in hindsight. The GM secretly rolls a d20. If the creature’s fate is too uncertain, or on if the roll is 5 or lower, the reading yields the word “inconclusive.” Either way, you cannot use this ability 5 on that creature again until you complete a long rest.

Augury (Sp)

At 6th level, as a standard action, you can discard 10 cards from your deck to cast augury. You ignore the material components of this spell.

Prediction (Su)

At 11th level, as an action, you make a prediction about a creature you can see within 30 feet.

Discard three cards from your hand. This prediction must be that the creature will either fail or succeed at a particular type of check, such as an skill check, attack roll, or saving throw. The target rolls twice and either takes the higher or lower result of the two rolls, your choice when the ability is used, on the next check of that type made within 1 round. The target is then immune to your use of this ability for 1 minute.

Find the Path (Sp)

At 18th level, as a standard action action, you can discard 10 cards from your deck to cast find the path. You ignore the material components of this spell.
